<style>

        /* New Warm & Elegant Theme Colors */
        :root {
            --bg-color: #f4f1ee; /* Warm Off-White */
            --text-color: #5a5349; /* Warm Gray/Brown Body Text */
            --heading-color: #4a433a; /* Darker Warm Gray/Brown Headings */
            --accent-color: #8b8173; /* Muted Khaki/Taupe Accent */
            --font-serif: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
            --font-sans: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;

            /* Existing non-color variables kept for structure */
            --shadow-subtle: 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
            --border-radius: 12px;
        }

        /* General Styles */
        body {
            font-family: var(--font-sans);
            background-color: var(--bg-color);
            color: var(--text-color);
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            line-height: 1.6;
        }
        .container {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 0 20px;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }
        h1, h2, h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-serif);
            font-weight: 700;
            line-height: 1.1;
            margin-top: 0;
            color: var(--heading-color);
        }
        p {
            font-weight: 400;
            color: var(--text-color);
        }
        b, strong {
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--heading-color);
        }
        section {
            padding: 60px 0;
        }
        
        /* --- Hero Section --- */
        .hero-section {
            background-image: url('/img/bbb4.avif'); 
            background-size: cover;
            background-position: center center;
            position: relative; 
            overflow: hidden;
            min-height: 400px;
            color: var(--bg-color);
            padding: 80px 20px 60px;
            border-bottom-left-radius: 40px;
            border-bottom-right-radius: 40px;
            text-align: center;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            z-index: 1;
        }
        
        .hero-section::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
            z-index: 2;
        }
        
        .hero-section .container {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 3;
        }

        .hero-section h1 {
            font-size: clamp(30px, 5.5vw, 54px);
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 0;
            color: var(--bg-color);
            text-shadow: none;
        }

        /* --- Content & Philosophy --- */
        .content-wrap {
            padding: 40px 0;
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }
        .intro-text, .philosophy-box {
            margin-bottom: 50px;
        }
        .intro-text h2 {
            font-size: clamp(26px, 3.5vw, 36px);
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            color: var(--heading-color);
            line-height: 1.25;
        }
        .philosophy-box {
            background-color: var(--bg-color);
            border: 2px solid var(--accent-color);
            padding: 30px;
            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle);
            text-align: center;
        }
        .philosophy-box h2 {
            font-size: 32px;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            color: var(--accent-color);
        }
        .philosophy-box p {
            font-style: italic;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-color);
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }
        .philosophy-box p:last-child {
            margin-bottom: 0;
        }

        /* --- Services Grid --- */
        .services-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 30px;
            margin-bottom: 50px;
        }
        .service-card {
            background-color: #ffffff;
            padding: 30px;
            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle);
            border: 1px solid #eee;
            transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
        }
        .service-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-5px);
            box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
        }
        .service-card h3 {
            font-size: 24px;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            color: var(--heading-color);
        }
        .service-card p {
            font-size: 15px;
            line-height: 1.6;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        .service-card p:last-child {
            margin-bottom: 0;
        }
        .service-card ul {
            padding-left: 20px;
            margin: 10px 0;
        }
        .service-card li {
            font-size: 15px;
            line-height: 1.6;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
            color: var(--text-color);
        }

        /* --- Why Choose Us --- */
        .why-choose-us {
            margin-bottom: 50px;
        }
        .why-choose-us h2 {
            font-size: 32px;
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            color: var(--accent-color);
        }
        .why-choose-intro {
            text-align: center;
            max-width: 800px;
            margin: 0 auto 30px;
            font-size: 16px;
        }
        .why-choose-intro p {
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        .reason-list {
            list-style: none;
            padding: 0;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr));
            gap: 20px;
        }
        .reason-list li {
            background: #ffffff;
            padding: 20px;
            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
            border-left: 5px solid var(--accent-color);
            font-size: 15px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle);
        }
        .reason-list strong {
            display: block;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
            font-size: 16px;
            color: var(--heading-color);
        }
        .final-cta-message {
            margin-top: 30px;
            text-align: center;
            font-style: italic;
            font-size: 15px;
            color: var(--heading-color);
        }
        .final-cta-message a {
            color: var(--accent-color);
            text-decoration: underline;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        /* --- FAQ Section --- */
        .faq-section {
            margin-bottom: 50px;
        }
        .faq-section h2 {
            font-size: 32px;
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 30px;
            color: var(--accent-color);
        }
        .faq-list {
            max-width: 900px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }
        .faq-item {
            background-color: #ffffff;
            padding: 20px;
            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle);
            border: 1px solid #eee;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }
        .faq-q {
            font-size: 18px;
            color: var(--heading-color);
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        .faq-a {
            font-size: 15px;
            color: var(--text-color);
            line-height: 1.6;
            margin: 0;
        }

        /* Learn More Button */
        .learn-more-wrap {
            text-align: center;
            margin-top: 35px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        .learn-more-btn {
            display: inline-block;
            background-color: var(--accent-color);
            color: #ffffff;
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 600;
            padding: 14px 38px;
            border-radius: 30px;
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(139, 129, 115, 0.3);
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }
        .learn-more-btn:hover {
            background-color: var(--heading-color);
            color: #ffffff;
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(74, 67, 58, 0.4);
        }

        /* --- Closing Section --- */
        .closing-section {
            padding: 40px;
            background-color: #ffffff;
            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle);
            border: 1px solid #eee;
            margin-top: 30px;
            text-align: center;
        }
        .closing-section h2 {
            font-size: 32px;
            color: var(--accent-color);
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }
        .closing-section p {
            max-width: 900px;
            margin: 0 auto 15px;
            font-size: 16px;
            line-height: 1.7;
        }
        .closing-section p a {
            color: var(--accent-color);
            font-weight: 600;
            text-decoration: underline;
        }

        /* --- Work Done / Project Showcase Gallery Carousel --- */
        .work-gallery-section {
            margin-top: 50px;
            margin-bottom: 50px;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .gallery-header {
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 35px;
            padding: 0 20px;
        }
        .gallery-header h2 {
            font-size: clamp(26px, 4vw, 36px);
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            color: var(--heading-color);
        }
        .gallery-header p {
            font-size: 16px;
            max-width: 750px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            color: var(--text-color);
        }
        .gallery-carousel-wrapper {
            width: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
            padding: 15px 0 25px;
            -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, black 4%, black 96%, transparent);
            mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, black 4%, black 96%, transparent);
        }
        .gallery-carousel-track {
            display: flex;
            width: max-content;
            animation: infiniteGalleryScroll 30s linear infinite;
            will-change: transform;
        }
        .gallery-carousel-wrapper:hover .gallery-carousel-track,
        .gallery-carousel-wrapper:active .gallery-carousel-track {
            animation-play-state: paused;
        }
        .gallery-carousel-group {
            display: flex;
            gap: 25px;
            padding-right: 25px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .gallery-card {
            width: 320px;
            max-width: 340px;
            background-color: #ffffff;
            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle);
            border: 1px solid rgba(139, 129, 115, 0.2);
            transition: transform 0.35s ease, box-shadow 0.35s ease, border-color 0.35s ease;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .gallery-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-8px);
            box-shadow: 0 14px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
            border-color: var(--accent-color);
        }
        .gallery-img-wrap {
            width: 100%;
            height: 240px;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
            background-color: #e5e0d8;
            border-radius: inherit;
        }
        .gallery-img-wrap img {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
            display: block;
            transition: transform 0.6s ease;
        }
        .gallery-card:hover .gallery-img-wrap img {
            transform: scale(1.08);
        }
        @keyframes infiniteGalleryScroll {
            0% {
                transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translate3d(-25%, 0, 0);
            }
        }
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            .gallery-carousel-track {
                animation: none;
            }
            .gallery-carousel-wrapper {
                overflow-x: auto;
                -webkit-mask-image: none;
                mask-image: none;
            }
        }        /* Mobile Responsiveness */
        @media (max-width: 767px) {
            .hero-section {
                padding: 60px 16px 40px;
                border-radius: 0;
            }
            .content-wrap.container {
                padding-left: 0;
                padding-right: 0;
                padding-top: 25px;
                padding-bottom: 25px;
            }
            .intro-text {
                width: calc(100% - 32px);
                max-width: 100%;
                margin-left: auto;
                margin-right: auto;
                box-sizing: border-box;
                margin-bottom: 35px;
            }
            .intro-text h2 {
                font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 6.5vw, 2.1rem);
                line-height: 1.22;
                margin-bottom: 16px;
            }
            .intro-text p {
                font-size: 16px;
                line-height: 1.7;
                margin-bottom: 15px;
            }
            .philosophy-box {
                width: calc(100% - 32px);
                max-width: 100%;
                margin-left: auto;
                margin-right: auto;
                padding: 26px 16px;
                border-radius: 16px;
                box-sizing: border-box;
                overflow: hidden;
                margin-bottom: 40px;
            }
            .philosophy-box h2 {
                margin: 0 0 22px;
                text-align: center;
                font-size: clamp(1.85rem, 7vw, 2.25rem);
                line-height: 1.18;
                overflow-wrap: break-word;
            }
            .philosophy-box p {
                width: 100%;
                margin: 0 0 20px;
                padding: 0;
                text-align: left;
                text-indent: 0;
                font-size: 17px;
                line-height: 1.7;
                overflow-wrap: break-word;
                word-break: normal;
                hyphens: none;
            }
            .philosophy-box p:last-child {
                margin-bottom: 0;
            }
            .services-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
                gap: 20px;
                width: calc(100% - 32px);
                margin-left: auto;
                margin-right: auto;
                box-sizing: border-box;
                margin-bottom: 40px;
            }
            .why-choose-us,
            .faq-section {
                width: calc(100% - 32px);
                margin-left: auto;
                margin-right: auto;
                box-sizing: border-box;
            }
            .gallery-card {
                width: 280px;
            }
            .gallery-img-wrap {
                height: 200px;
            }
            .gallery-carousel-group {
                gap: 18px;
                padding-right: 18px;
            }
            .gallery-carousel-track {
                animation-duration: 22s;
            }
            .closing-section {
                width: calc(100% - 32px);
                margin-left: auto;
                margin-right: auto;
                box-sizing: border-box;
                padding: 25px 16px;
                border-radius: 16px;
            }
            .process-card-row {
                flex-direction: column;
            }
        }

        @media (min-width: 481px) and (max-width: 767px) {
            .intro-text,
            .philosophy-box,
            .services-grid,
            .why-choose-us,
            .faq-section,
            .closing-section {
                width: calc(100% - 40px);
            }
        }
    </style>

    <div class="container content-wrap">

        <!-- INTRO -->
        <div class="intro-text">
            <h2>Best Interior Designers for Beautiful and Practical Spaces</h2>
            <p>Interior spaces should be comfortable, functional, and reflective of the people who use them. With the <b>Best Interior Designers in Delhi</b>, home and business owners can create interiors that are both stylish and practical. Whether it is an apartment, an independent house, an office, or a retail showroom, good design is about using space wisely, choosing suitable materials, and creating a balanced layout.</p>
            <p>Every space has different requirements. A home needs warmth, relaxation, and smart storage, while a workplace needs an efficient setup that supports daily activities. Working with the best interior designers in Delhi ensures that every corner of the room is planned with purpose, comfort, and long-term use in mind.</p>
        </div>

        <!-- PHILOSOPHY / SERVICE OVERVIEW -->
        <div class="philosophy-box">
            <h2>Efficient Indoor Designs for Simple, Useful, and Personal Spaces</h2>
            <p>A well-designed interior does not need to be complicated. Simple layouts, balanced colors, good lighting, and useful furniture can make a space feel open and organized.</p>
            <p>Our team believes that good design should support everyday life. For clients looking for the <b>Best Interior Designers in Delhi</b>, we focus on combining visual appeal with daily convenience, ensuring that every design choice has a purpose.</p>
        </div>

        <!-- SERVICE CATEGORIES GRID (4 CARDS) -->
        <div class="services-grid">
            
            <div class="service-card">
                <h3>Residential Interior Design</h3>
                <p>The best interior designers know that a home should be a comfortable place where families can relax and spend time together. Our residential interior design services cover living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, dining areas, study spaces, and balconies.</p>
                <p>We plan furniture placement to ensure easy movement throughout the room. Storage solutions are designed to keep the space tidy without taking up unnecessary area.</p>
                <p>Colours, lighting, wall finishes, and décor are selected according to the size and style of the home.</p>
                <p>Whether you are setting up a new apartment or redesigning an existing house, our goal is to create living spaces that feel welcoming and easy to maintain.</p>
            </div>
            
            <div class="service-card">
                <h3>Commercial & Office Interiors</h3>
                <p>A well-planned commercial interior by the best interior designers can create a positive impression on clients and provide a comfortable environment for employees. We design offices, corporate workspaces, showrooms, retail outlets, and meeting rooms.</p>
                <p>Our office designs focus on organized workstations, functional cabins, clear movement paths, and proper lighting to support daily business operations.</p>
                <p>For showrooms and retail spaces, we plan product displays and customer areas to ensure easy browsing and a professional look.</p>
                <p>As one of the <b>top interior designers in Delhi</b>, we create commercial spaces that balance business needs with modern design.</p>
            </div>
